generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
BIDDERS SHALL ENSURE TO UPLOAD RELEVANT DOCUMENT CERTIFYING HIS/HER STATUS AS SCHEDULED CASTE RESERVED CATEGORY AS PRESCRIBED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

BIDDERS SHALL ENSURE TO UPLOAD VALID DOMICILE OR RESIDENCE CERTFICATEAS PER THE STANDARDS AND GOVT GAZETTE. THE CERTIFICATE SHOULD MENTION THAT THE APPLICANT HAS BEEN A RESIDENT OF KARNATAKA STATE FOR MORE THAN 10 YEARS
THE BIDDER SHOULD READ ALL THE GENERAL CONDITION IN INSTRUCTION TO BIDDER FILE IN THE TENDER AND OBEY ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITION
THE RATES INCLUDES ALL LEADS, LIFTS, LOADING, UNLOADING, COST AND CONVEYANCE OF ALL MATERIALS, LABOUR, EQUIPMENTS ETC COMPLETE AS PER THE DIRECTION OF THE ENGINEER IN CHARGE OF WORK

THE BIDDER SHALL QUOTE RATES WITHOUT ADDING GST FOR EITHER MATERIALS OR WORKS CONTRACT OR SERVICE GST PAYABLE BY THE BIDDER UNDER THIS WORKS CONTRACT WILL BE PAID TO THE CONTRACTOR OVER AND ABOVE THE BIDDERS BID AMOUNT. AND THE INCREASE IN THE GST SHALL NOT BE PAID IN THE EXTENDED PERIOD OF CONTRACT FOR WHICH THE BIDDER ALONE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DELAY AS DETERMINED BY THE AUTHORITY

THE TENDERER SHOULD SUBMIT THE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE ALONG WITH THE APPLICATION. (SHOULD BE ENROLLED AND RENEWED IN PWD) (CLASS 3& ABOVE CONTRACTOR ONLY)CONTRACTOR BELONGING TO CLASS 3 SHOULD BE ENROLLED IN HASSAN CIRCLE)

THE BIDDER SHOULD ACHIEVED IN ATLEAST TWO FINANCIAL YEARS AN AVERAGE ANNUAL FINANCIAL TURNOVER CIVIL ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION WORKS NOT LESS THAN THE TENDER AMOUNT IN ALL CLASSES OF CIVIL ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION WORKS ONLY OF RS 23.58 LAKHS
CALCULATED BID CAPACITY OF BIDDER SHOULD BE MORE THAN TENDER VALUE RS 23.58 LAKHS
REPORTS OF THE UDIN AND CHARTED ACCOUNTANT CERTIFIED FINANCIAL STANDING OF THE TENDERER, SUCH AS PROFIT AND LOSS STATEMENTS AND CA REPORTS FOR THE LAST FIVE YEARSFROM 2021-22 to 2025-26
